instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Vertex Consulting is a boutique management consulting firm specializing in strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation for mid-market clients across sectors like finance and healthcare. The firm employs 40 consultants across three regional offices, typically delivering high-impact engagements lasting 8 to 16 weeks.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm through quarterly hackathons aimed at rapid prototyping and a formal patent portfolio review. We successfully piloted an automated quality inspection tool using computer vision, which has since been operational, resulting in a documented 35% reduction in defect escape rates for clients.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base, represented by our top three clients accounting for 55% of annual revenue. We must identify and develop new, high-margin revenue streams, potentially through specialized service lines or entirely new business models that leverage our core strategic capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The current market demands rapid service scaling and demonstrable digital innovation, pressuring Vertex to transition from a service provider model to an integrated solution partner.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Proposal & Insight Engine Implementation
opportunities.rationale: Expanding the knowledge management AI initiative beyond simple insight surfacing into a full proposal generation tool would significantly increase efficiency and allow for faster service delivery. This is a low-risk, immediate win that leverages existing internal data.

first_actions: Finalize scope definition for the Q3 AI knowledge base integration.
resources_needed: Minor SaaS licensing for specialized NLP features ($5k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase proposal generation cycle speed by 20% and reduce consultant manual data entry hours by 15%.

opportunities.title: Niche Vertical Service Line Development
opportunities.rationale: To achieve diversification, Vertex should identify a high-growth niche (e.g., Supply Chain Resilience Consulting for mid-market manufacturing) and package proprietary methodologies into specialized, repeatable service offerings. This minimizes market competition while capitalizing on existing domain expertise.

first_actions: Conduct a gap analysis of current skill sets against three potential niche verticals.
Develop core white-paper content for two target niches.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 new recurring contracts within the first year in the chosen niche.

opportunities.title: Proprietary Methodology SaaS Productization
opportunities.rationale: This bold approach involves packaging Vertex's successful operational excellence framework into a modular, subscription-based SaaS tool sold to other consulting firms or internal divisions. This fundamentally shifts revenue from time/labor to scalable product sales.

first_actions: Define the minimum viable feature set for the SaaS core module.
Engage a fractional CEO/Product Lead to define the go-to-market strategy.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve $50k MRR from SaaS subscription revenue within 18 months.

next_steps.action: Initiate scoping and resource allocation for the AI Proposal Engine MVP.
Conduct a comprehensive market assessment identifying two high-potential niche verticals for service line diversification.
Draft the initial business case and technical roadmap for the radical SaaS productization effort, securing executive buy-in.

key_weaknesses: Tight budget constraint limiting investment in large R&D or infrastructure projects.
High reliance on a single product category and concentrated revenue base, posing significant diversification risk.
Limited middle management layers leading to potential bottlenecks in scaling innovation efforts.
Potential difficulty carving out dedicated time for complex innovation bets amidst high operational demands.
